# Physlint

Physlint is a local-first, deterministic integrity validator for robot-learning datasets and recordings.

Documentation:
- README: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint#readme
- Agent workflow: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/blob/master/docs/agents.md
- Python API: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/blob/master/docs/python-api.md
- Rule contract: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/tree/master/docs/rules
- Plugin SDK: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/blob/master/docs/plugins.md
- JSON Schemas: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/tree/master/schemas

Safe machine workflow:
1. `physlint inspect SOURCE --format json`
2. `physlint check SOURCE --format json --safe`
3. Parse stdout on exit 0 or 1; parse the JSON error on stderr for exit 2, 3, 4, or 130.

Never equate a pass with task success, policy quality, calibration, or robot safety.
